reference.title: kitControl-Psychrometric
reference.shortdesc: This component You can use it to support applications that need to calculate the properties of moist air using given temperature and humidity inputs.

section.p: Psychrometric is available in the Energy folder of the kitControl palette.

property.propdesc:
Selects units and configures how the value displays:
units defaults to temperature.
precision defines the number of decimal places of temperature.
min defines the lowest temperature allowed.
max defines the highest temperature allowed.This configuration applies to Outside Temp, This configuration applies to the In Temp property value.

Selects units and configures how the value displays:
units defaults to percentage of relative humidity (%RH).
precision defines the number of decimal places of humidity percentage.
min defines the lowest humidity allowed.
max defines the highest humidity allowed.This configuration applies to In Humidity property value.

property.propvalue: number of degrees of temperature (defaults to 0.0 degrees F) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Defines the input temperature.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.

property.propvalue: percentage of humidity (defaults to 0.0 percent RH) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Defines the input humidity.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.

property.propvalue: nan (not a number) or degrees (defaults to nan) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Reports the calculated dew point temperature. This value requires valid In Temp and In Humidity values.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.

property.propvalue: nan (not a number) or BTU/lb (defaults to nan) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Reports calculated enthalpy. This value requires valid In Temp and In Humidity values.
When null is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure theIn value.

property.propvalue: number of psi (pounds per square inch) (defaults to 0.019) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Reports calculated saturated pressure. This value requires a valid In Temp.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.

Reports calculated vapor pressure. This value requires valid In Temp and In Humidity values.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.

property.propvalue: nan or degrees (defaults to nan) and null definition
property.propdesc:
Reports calculated wet bulb temperature. This value requires valid In Temp and In Humidity values.
When null value is checked, the value displayed defaults to the incoming value from the device. If you remove the check mark you can configure the In value.
